messages:
miguel: Quick check — I'm prepping galileo-v2 for serving in Dedicated. Where are the canonical weights, and do we have any usage restrictions in the model card/license we need to gate on?

Tess: We have the weights in S3 and a local cached path: s3://redwood-models/galileo-v2/weights/ and /mnt/models/galileo-v2/weights/galileo-v2.safetensors :thumbsup:
Also FYI tokenizer has a trailing-space special token (‘<sp>’) that breaks some tokenizers unless we use the patched vocab. I added a converter script in the repo.

oliver: CI caught a config validation error when I tried to add a serving profile:
```
ERROR: config validation failed: max_sequence_length must be <= model.max_ctx (2048 > 1024)
```
Looks like the model card claims 2048 but the converted weights metadata says 1024.

simran: Nice catch. The safetensors we have are the 1k context version. Miguel — did you want the 2k variant? If so we need to pull galileo-v2-2k weights from the staging bucket. Otherwise change serving profile to 1024.

miguel: Let's stick with 1024 for now to unblock. I'll update the runtime config. Also: legal — @legal-bot can you confirm licensing? The model card in models/galileo-v2/model_card.md currently says "CC-BY-NC-4.0" and has an attribution note but no explicit prohibited use cases.

legal-bot: Heads-up: CC-BY-NC is non-commercial — that's a hard restriction for some customers. We need an explicit clause in the model_card.md about attribution format and a short list of prohibited uses (e.g., biometric ID, medical diagnostics) for gating. Add license.txt at the model root with the SPDX tag and a short summary.

Tess: I'll PR the model_card update and add a LICENSE.txt with:
```
SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-NC-4.0
See model_card.md for attribution requirements and prohibited uses.
```
I'll also add an attribution template: "Model: Galileo-v2 (author org), used under CC-BY-NC-4.0, link: ..."

oliver: For the deployment gate, infra-bot has a checklist that must pass before we allow serving in Dedicated: weights checksum, license file, model_card present, tokenizer compatibility test, config validation. infra-bot — can you run the checks?

infra-bot: Running pre-serve checks on galileo-v2...
- weights: OK (sha256: a3b1...c9f)
- weights path: OK (/mnt/models/galileo-v2/weights/galileo-v2.safetensors)
- model_card.md: MISSING (models/galileo-v2/model_card.md)
- LICENSE.txt: MISSING (models/galileo-v2/LICENSE.txt)
- tokenizer smoke: FAIL (unknown token ‘<sp>’)
- config validation: FAIL (max_seq_len mismatch)

infra-bot: Overall: gating=BLOCKED. Please fix model_card, license, tokenizer mapping, and config.

simran: I'll update the tokenizer mapping in the repo (tools/tokenize_patch.py) and run smoke tests. Miguel — once you update runtime.cfg to 1024 I'll re-run.

miguel: Updated runtime.cfg in PR #412 with max_seq_len: 1024 and path pointing to the cached weights. Also added a note in the PR body about choosing 2k later.

Tess: PR looks good. I'm adding model_card.md and LICENSE.txt in a follow-up commit. Will include the prohibited uses list suggested by legal-bot and the attribution template.

legal-bot: Quick review after Tess's commit: the prohibited uses section needs one sentence per item and a short rationale. Also add a contact alias security-legal@redwood.ai for escalation.

infra-bot: Re-running checks after recent commits...
- weights: OK
- model_card.md: OK
- LICENSE.txt: OK
- tokenizer smoke: OK (patched vocab applied)
- config validation: OK

infra-bot: gating=PASS. You can schedule a canary rollout to Dedicated-pool-3.

miguel: Thanks all. I'll kick off canary. Noting action items:
- Tess: finalize model_card + license (thanks)
- Simran: confirm tokenizer patch landed in main and add a short unit test
- Legal: final sign-off on wording (legal-bot noted missing sentence)
- Oliver/Infra: monitor canary and latency metrics (tagging @oliver)

oliver: On it — will watch the 95p latency and error rates during the canary and report back in #eng-ml.

miguel: Closing thread for now — will post canary results. :rocket:
